trigger: Low-rank cross-validation showed rank-1 improvement in AusTraits but no meaningful low-rank gain in BIEN.
model: Fit rank-1 family-by-trait bilinear factor at the cross-validated lambda=0.3 separately for S3 and prune-only.
outputs: trait loadings on each tree axis
family scores on each tree axis
descriptive organ-group means for vegetative dimensions, reproductive-size traits, and other traits
correlation of family scores with woody and perennial fractions
role: post-outcome interpretation only; organ groups are descriptive after the latent factor was observed and are not inferentially pre-registered.
hard_nonclaims: Do not call the axis a universal regime because BIEN did not show low-rank predictive gain.
Do not assign a causal mechanism from trait loading signs alone.
The sign of a latent factor is arbitrary; align prune to S3 before interpretation.
